observation: One isolated reader observation; no real experiment, project mutation, external write or production acceptance.
applicable_rules: AGENTS §§1–5: current authority, bounded scope, capability != authority, ownership, current durable truth, evidence and trace. Authenticated access/current target state are VERIFIED fixture inputs.
Bootstrap §§1–3: ordered recovery from addressing, global/local/work rules, authority/access/currentness. The durable Work Order supplies current project contract/state and frozen experiment scope.

Agent Interface §§1.0,1.3–1.4: isolated mutable workspace; pre-existing acceptance; eligible DIRECT work needs no ceremonial Builder dispatch. Preserve required review; no merge/deploy/admin authority.
Agent Interface §§1.7–1.9: continue to durable acceptance, repair ordinary in-scope failures; unavailable warm context triggers FRESH_CONTEXT reconstruction.
Durable Trace: checkpoint reusable research/verification at semantic boundaries with source, limits, remaining work and recoverable pointers. A short task may use final completion only.

Change Lifecycle §§1–4: committed report Artifacts retain history and applicable review. Substantive durable-fact updates can be L1; this comparison creates no L2/ADR by itself. Existing Work Order anchors rationale/acceptance.
Constitution §§5–7: evidence bounds claims; preserve required review without inventing multiple verifiers. AGENTS §7: simplified Chinese narrative default.
can_ignore: Full-repository/history/unrelated-project reading, workspace-wide OPEN work, registration, diagrams, migrations, release/deploy and Incident machinery: no trigger.

Mandatory ARCH-0 or External Wheel Admission Gate: no material architecture choice, pivot or production import. Reconnaissance §2 exempts narrow frozen-design work; §8 separates findings from adoption.
Standalone ADR, independent verifier or delegated Builder merely because an Architect researches; retain actual Work Order/risk requirements.
Historical Session §5 broad scans and Human confirmation stop; current Reading Map, Bootstrap and Interface supersede them.
Old chat/handoff restoration, redesigning the frozen experiment, upstream private-control-plane access, or renewed Human permission merely because context crashed.

native_capability_reuse.source_proven_rule: Constitution §3 prefers GitHub native relationships, labels, reviews, milestones and Projects durable facts over a second natural-language status database. Bootstrap §1A prefers an available authenticated native GitHub capability, then authenticated gh; tool access grants no authority.
native_capability_reuse.application: Use source-proven native features that meet frozen needs; cite official/upstream sources or observed behavior and evidence window. Do not invent API/currentness facts, import a framework, or duplicate SSOT merely to report comparison gaps.
native_capability_reuse.limit: No named tools, measurements or winner established: this fixture evaluates rule interpretation only.

owner_local_design.answer: Use the frozen owner-project Work Order as design/scope/acceptance. Recover it from current durable state; do not redesign because context crashed. Keep project evidence/facts in the owner project with exact work pointers, not copied into global governance.
owner_local_design.change_boundary: A new architecture, ownership or long-lived contract choice would be a separate authorized scope and potentially L2/ADR; no such choice is supplied here.

done_current_production_evidence.done: Meet durable experiment acceptance and required review with reproducible comparisons, source pointers, method and limitations. Applicable artifact/head/check evidence follows the Work Order; self-report is insufficient. Merge/deploy are neither required nor authorized here.
done_current_production_evidence.current: Use VERIFIED fixture authority/access/target state. Real execution binds claims/review to current sources and relevant exact refs; stop on material drift. Classify old evidence current/superseded/historical; checkpoints are not authority.
done_current_production_evidence.production: Neither a bounded comparison nor this one model observation proves production readiness, architecture approval, adoption authority or production acceptance. Those need separate scope, evidence and authority.

recovery.reason: The durable Work Order/current fixture state replaces unavailable old working memory. Use FRESH_CONTEXT; no need to demand old chat/handoff or new Human confirmation.
extra_required_gates: Bootstrap §3C requires durable bootstrap writeback before a real fresh/takeover Architect claims cold-start complete/EXECUTION_ALLOWED. Retained as reporting, not new approval/missing-state blocker. Benchmark forbids external writes, so no real execution-ready claim was made.
